description: This file declares the ExceptionHandler class for MacOS, which manages crash exception handling, minidump creation, and related callbacks within the Google Breakpad crash reporting system.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Manages MacOS exception handling, minidump generation, and crash reporting callbacks.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Triggers immediate minidump creation, optionally including exception stream.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpForChild
methods.description: Creates a minidump for a child process.

methods.name: IsOutOfProcess
methods.description: Checks if out-of-process dump generation is used.
